payload.reason: The evidence discusses the transfer of encoders from one language to another without parameter updates and mentions the evaluation of downstream tasks, indicating that such tasks have been tested.

claims.text: Downstream tasks such as natural language inference, question answering, and semantic role labeling have been tested using an encoder transferred from language 1 to language 2 without parameter updates.
The Test for Inductive Bias via Language Model Transfer (TILT) framework evaluates the transferability of encoders to downstream tasks in a target language.
